data.body:
CI remediation round 2 -> pushed patch set 4 to Gerrit change 1376 (Change-Id If7bd2a6...). 

PS3 Verified-1 had two failing jobs:
1. pytest (ubuntu, py3.12): test_git_contention_9305.py::test_uncontended_write_never_sleeps failed - asserted zero sleeps on the uncontended happy path but observed [0.001]. Root cause: run_git_write now passes timeout=_LOCAL_GIT_TIMEOUT to subprocess.run; on POSIX, stdlib Popen._wait(timeout) busy-polls with time.sleep(~0.001) when the child-reap race hits (common on loaded CI runners). The test's GLOBAL time.sleep monkeypatch mis-counted that stdlib internal sleep as rebar-added latency. Fix: routed rebar's three deliberate backoff sleeps through a new gitutil._backoff_sleep seam and made the test patch that seam, so it measures ONLY rebar's intentional backoff (behavior unchanged). All 9 contention tests pass locally.
2. verify-identity: 'tickets pack is 131431 KiB; limit is 131072 KiB' - GLOBAL tickets-store pack-size limit, not code in this change; will fail ANY change until an operator compacts the tickets pack. Not fixable here.

Also rebased onto current origin/main (was 7 commits behind) to avoid a stale-merge-preview artifact. Local: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (430 files), targeted contention suite 9/9. Note: tests/interfaces/store/test_tracker_config_e2e.py::test_custom_dir_and_branch_init_and_sync_roundtrip fails identically on pristine origin/main on this host (for-each-ref exit 128) - pre-existing/host env, not this change. Leaving 9305 in_progress pending Verified+1 / merge.
